scope: Static Option type delta only. Semantic qualification, data generation, consumer integration, runtime behavior, builds and publication are separate gates.

structural_semantics.basis: Static inspection of unchanged derived Serde attributes; no deserialization program was run.
structural_semantics.old_string: Present string values continue to deserialize as Some(String).
structural_semantics.absent_or_null: An absent key or explicit null can structurally deserialize as None; deny_unknown_fields does not enforce key presence.
structural_semantics.empty_string: An empty string is structurally Some(""); it is not an absence marker and must fail hardware qualification.
structural_semantics.serialization: The inner Option field has no skip_serializing_if. Project-serde Some serializes as the prior string value; None serializes as explicit null. The existing outer lsi_sysclk Option and its omission policy are unchanged.
structural_semantics.other_fields: No other model bytes, field order, width, attributes, derives or comments changed.

semantic_acceptance_requirements: Authored raw policy must explicitly contain lsi_output_pin before typed decoding; missing is rejected independently of Option decoding.
Only the qualified CW32F002F3P7 and CW32F002F3U7 facts may use null/None after own-source and complete AF absence validation. None alone is not hardware authority.
None requires empty lsi_output_allowed_af; Some requires a nonempty valid pin and the complete nonempty legal AF set. Reject None with AF values, Some with empty AF, and fake empty-string absence.
Classic qualified families retain Some("PB11"), RTC and direct-output inspection with all existing source values, operation statements, order and semantics.
RTC presence and its source allowlist must agree: F002 has no RTC and an empty list; classic RTC cannot be skipped because a list was emptied.
Exact-package/source/IR/presence/allowlist validation must reject aliases, F003 and unqualified families rather than infer absence or eligibility from Option.

rust_api.visible_change: Owned public fields are Option<String>; static metadata is Option<&'static str>. Struct literals, field consumers and Debug/generated Rust shape change. No Rust source or ABI compatibility is claimed.
rust_api.classic_generated_shape: Classic JSON string values can stay equal while generated Rust changes from lsi_output_pin: "PB11" to lsi_output_pin: Some("PB11"). Whole generated Rust metadata is not byte-identical.
rust_api.generator_path: cw32-metapac-gen/src/lib.rs stringify uses derived Debug and slice rewriting. The owned/static Option shapes correspond; generated output has not been executed or accepted by this review.

consumer_review.direct_search: Source-wide including ignored files search for lsi_output_pin, LsiSysclk and PeripheralLsiSysclk found the three models, policy/profile values, historical review records and embassy-cw32/build.rs direct reads.
consumer_review.observed_incomplete_state: The in-progress build consumer still used direct string as_bytes/index operations and unconditional RTC/direct-output roots when inspected. No consumer pass or compilation success is claimed.
consumer_review.needed_evidence: Frozen validator/raw-key/None-Some checks and build generator review, followed by separately authorized actual generation demonstrating exact2 and classic metadata/root differences.
